description: Source code implementing process execution functions for Windows and POSIX systems, including process creation, pipe handling, and process waiting.

methods.name: ExecProcess
methods.description: Executes a process with given command line and startup directory, capturing stdout, stderr, and exit code, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: ReadFromPipe
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor and appends it to a string, handling non-blocking I/O.

methods.name: WaitForExit
methods.description: Waits for a process to exit given its PID, retrieves the exit code.
